messages:
Maya: Heads-up — final publish for the optimizer benchmark blog is scheduled Thu 10:00 UTC. Embargo lifts at 10:00 UTC. Draft here: https://go.redwood/opt-bench-draft
Liam: Got it. I'm prepping the press list and sending embargo emails at 09:45 UTC. Who's on monitoring duty for immediate follow-ups? @Evan?
Evan: I'll be on post-publish for any technical follow-ups and to triage traffic. Numbers in the doc are final; re-run logs are attached. Also added a short FAQ about perf variance.
Jules: CDN purge scheduled T+00:10, cache-control headers set to 5m for the new post. I'll open a release-control channel 15m before.
Maya: @Liam please include the "benchmark highlights" TL;DR and the quote from CEO (finalized below). Also note embargo line: 'Do not publish before Thu 10:00 UTC.'
Liam: Will do. Sending embargo notices now.
press-bot: Reminder scheduled: embargo_email_sender will fire at 09:45 UTC (in 40m)
Comms: Quick confirm — do we want to tag PartnerX in the release? Partner legal cleared it yesterday.
Maya: Yes, tag PartnerX and add the partner quote. Also add a small "how we measured" callout. Evan — can you add the single-sentence methodology to the top of the bench section?
Evan: Added: "Benchmarks run on Dedicated v2, 8xA100, 2048 context, median latency over 5 runs." Pushed to doc.
Liam: Press list: NYT, TechCrunch, The Register, VentureBeat, Sifted. Extra outreach to key EU reporters at 09:50 UTC.
Maya: Action items:
- Liam: embargo emails + press outreach
- Evan: monitor infra + prepare short FAQ
- Jules: CDN + release-control channel
- Maya: publish blog + social copy go-ahead
Please react with :thumbsup: when ready.
Liam: :thumbsup:
Evan: :thumbsup:
Jules: :thumbsup:
Maya: Cool. I'll do a dry run of the publish steps now. Snippet for publish script:
```
# manual publish snippet
curl -X POST https://console.redwood/publish -d '{"slug":"optimize-benchmark"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $PUBLISH_TOKEN'
```
Maya: If anything blocks, call the release-control channel. Otherwise see you at 09:55 UTC for final sync.
